app.title: MuxSpace — Session Dashboard

lang.label: Language
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to continue.
grid.empty_hint: Pick a session in the sidebar to view it here.
tile.search_placeholder: Search a command or type one (Enter to send)… (Esc to clear)
tile.confirm_kill:
Kill the tmux session "{name}"?

This runs "tmux kill-session" on the server: the session and everything running in it will be lost. This can't be undone.
sidebar.space_empty: This space has no sessions. Move one here from another space.
sidebar.hide_tile: Close the tile (the terminal stays alive)
sidebar.commands_hint: They run in the focused terminal (or in a new one if there is none).
sidebar.confirm_delete_command: Delete the command "{label}" from the library?
sidebar.run_in_new_session: Open in a new session and run
sidebar.projects_hint: They open a new session: cd to the directory + a list of commands.
sidebar.confirm_delete_project: Delete the project "{title}" from the library?
sidebar.run_project: Open in a new session and run the sequence
sidebar.run_project_new_tab: Open the project in its own space, in a new tab
form.session_name_hint: Letters, numbers, hyphen (-) and underscore (_) only. A slash "/" becomes "_".
form.project_title_default_placeholder: project title (defaults to the session name)
form.project_title_hint: This becomes the tmux session name. A slash "/" becomes "_".
spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.confirm_delete_empty:
Delete the space "{title}"?

It has no sessions assigned.

spaces.confirm_delete.one:
Delete the space "{title}"?

Its {count} session is NOT killed: it goes back to "Unassigned".
spaces.confirm_delete.other:
Delete the space "{title}"?

Its {count} sessions are NOT killed: they go back to "Unassigned".
